sources.sourceName: 获取拣选场景等待时间总览
sources.content:
select site_name, 
round(avg(man_await_times)::numeric / 60, 2) as avg_man_times,
round(avg(amr_await_times)::numeric / 60, 2) as avg_amr_times
from workbench_task
where 1=1 and [create_time >= ${startTime} and create_time <= ${endTime}]
and [work_range = ${workRange}]
and [map_code = ${mapCode}]
and [(site_name || ',' || coo_x || ',' || coo_y) in (${siteInfo})]
and [man_await_model = ${model}]
group by site_name
order by site_name

sources.content:
select tt.task_chain_code
        from
        tbl_task tt left join (
        select task_chain_code,task_chain_type,create_time,map_code,derive,
        row_number() over(partition by task_chain_code order by create_time desc nulls last) as rn,
        first_value(start_zone) over(partition by task_chain_code order by start_zone is not null desc) as start_zone,
        first_value(end_zone) over(partition by task_chain_code order by end_zone is not null desc) as end_zone,
        first_value(eqpt_code) over(partition by task_chain_code order by eqpt_code is not null desc) as eqpt_code,
        first_value(eqpt_type) over(partition by task_chain_code order by eqpt_type is not null desc) as eqpt_type,
        min(case when be_interrupted = 0 then 0 else 1 end) over(partition by task_chain_code) as in_out
        from tbl_sub_task) ts
        on tt.task_chain_code = ts.task_chain_code
        where (ts.rn = 1 or ts.rn is null) and tt.task_status in ('9') and ts.derive = 0
            and tt.task_chain_type in (${task})
        	AND tt.create_time >= ${startTime} and tt.create_time <= ${endTime}
            AND [case when tt.map_code is not null then tt.map_code in (${mapCode}) else ts.map_code in (${mapCode}) end]
            AND [ts.eqpt_code in (${lineCode})]
            AND [(ts.end_zone in (${areaCode}) or ts.start_zone in (${areaCode}))]
            and [ts.in_out = ${workType}]

select amr_type_name,amr_category,amr_code
from dps_sync_amr da 
	left join dps_sync_amr_type dat 
	on da.type_code = dat.amr_type_code 
where dat.amr_category in ('10','40')

sources.sourceName: 获取大小车出入库详情
sources.content:
select 	coalesce(t1.map_code,t2.map_code,t3.map_code) as map_code,
		coalesce(t1.amr_type_name,t2.amr_type_name,t3.amr_type_name) as amr_type_name,
		coalesce(t1.amr_code,t2.amr_code,t3.amr_code) as amr_code
		,coalesce(t1.out_number,0) as out_number,coalesce(t1.out_avg_time,0) as out_avg_time,coalesce(t1.out_time,0) as out_time,
		coalesce(t2.in_number,0) as in_number,coalesce(t2.in_avg_time,0) as in_avg_time,coalesce(t2.in_time,0) as in_time,
		(coalesce(t1.out_time,0) + coalesce(t2.in_time,0)) as all_task_time,coalesce(t3.in_break_number,0) as in_break_number
from (
	select ts.amr_code, count(case when ts.carrier_code is not null then 1 end) as out_number,
	round(sum(ts.worktime :: numeric) / nullif(count(case when ts.carrier_code is not null then 1 end), 0) / 60 , 2 ) as out_avg_time,
	round(sum(ts.worktime :: numeric) / 60,2) as out_time,ts.map_code,ts.amr_type_name
	from (
		select ts1.amr_code,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (end_time - task_start_time)) as worktime,ts1.map_code,dat.amr_type_name,dat.amr_type_code,ts1.carrier_code,be_interrupted as in_out
		from tbl_sub_task ts1 left join dps_sync_amr da on ts1.amr_code = da.amr_code left join dps_sync_amr_type dat on da.type_code = dat.amr_type_code
		where task_status = '9' 
		and [ts1.map_code in (${mapCode})]
		and ts1.create_time >= ${startTime}
		and ts1.create_time <= ${endTime}
        and [ts1."range" = ${range}]
        and ts1.task_chain_type in (${task})
		order by create_time asc
	) as ts
    where ts.in_out = 0 and [ts.amr_type_code in (${amrType})] and [ts.amr_code in (${amrCode})]
	group by ts.amr_code,ts.map_code,ts.amr_type_name) as t1 
full outer join (
	select ts.amr_code, count(case when ts.carrier_code is not null then 1 end) as in_number,
	round(sum(ts.worktime :: numeric) / nullif(count(case when ts.carrier_code is not null then 1 end), 0) / 60 , 2 ) as in_avg_time,
	round(sum(ts.worktime :: numeric) / 60,2) as in_time,ts.map_code,ts.amr_type_name
	from (
		select ts2.amr_code,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (end_time - task_start_time)) as worktime,ts2.map_code,dat.amr_type_name,dat.amr_type_code,ts2.carrier_code,case when be_interrupted is null then 1 else be_interrupted end as in_out
		from tbl_sub_task ts2 left join dps_sync_amr da on ts2.amr_code = da.amr_code left join dps_sync_amr_type dat on da.type_code = dat.amr_type_code
		where task_status = '9' 
		and [ts2.map_code in (${mapCode})]
		and ts2.create_time >= ${startTime}
		and ts2.create_time <= ${endTime}
        and [ts2."range" = ${range}]
        and ts2.task_chain_type in (${task})
		order by create_time asc
	) as ts
    where ts.in_out = 1 and [ts.amr_type_code in (${amrType})] and [ts.amr_code in (${amrCode})]
	group by ts.amr_code,ts.map_code,ts.amr_type_name) as t2 on t1.amr_code = t2.amr_code 
full outer join (
	select ts.amr_code, count(case when ts.carrier_code is not null then 1 end) as in_break_number,ts.map_code,ts.amr_type_name
	from(
		select ts3.amr_code,ts3.map_code,dat.amr_type_name,dat.amr_type_code,ts3.carrier_code
		from tbl_sub_task ts3 left join dps_sync_amr da on ts3.amr_code = da.amr_code left join dps_sync_amr_type dat on da.type_code = dat.amr_type_code
		where task_status = '10' 
		and ts3.amr_code is not null
		and [ts3.map_code in (${mapCode})]
		and ts3.create_time >= ${startTime}
		and ts3.create_time <= ${endTime}
        and [ts3."range" = ${range}]
        and ts3.task_chain_type in (${task})
	)as ts
    where [ts.amr_type_code in (${amrType})] and [ts.amr_code in (${amrCode})]
	group by ts.amr_code,ts.map_code,ts.amr_type_name) as t3 on t1.amr_code = t3.amr_code

select count(*) as total_count,
    case
        when ${queryDateLength} = 7 then foo1.month_date
        when ${queryDateLength} = 10 then foo1.day_date
    else foo1.hour_date end as querydate
from (select tt.task_chain_code
	,to_char(tt.create_time,'YYYY-MM') as month_date,
	to_char(tt.create_time,'YYYY-MM-DD') as day_date,
	to_char(tt.create_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24') as hour_date
from
	tbl_task tt left join
	(select map_code,	
		row_number() over(partition by task_chain_code order by create_time asc nulls last) as rn,task_chain_code,
		first_value(start_zone) over(partition by task_chain_code order by start_zone is not null desc) as start_zone,
		first_value(end_zone) over(partition by task_chain_code order by end_zone is not null desc) as end_zone,
		first_value(eqpt_code) over(partition by task_chain_code order by eqpt_code is not null desc) as eqpt_code,
		first_value(eqpt_type) over(partition by task_chain_code order by eqpt_type is not null desc) as eqpt_type,
		case when count(case when (start_slot_category = 'SITE' and sub_task_type = 'MOVE_CARRIER') or (end_slot_category = 'SITE' and sub_task_type = 'MOVE_CARRIER') then 1 end) over (partition by task_chain_code) > 0 then 0 else 1 end as rack_flag,
		min(case when be_interrupted = 0 then 0 else 1 end) over (partition by task_chain_code) as in_out
	from tbl_sub_task 
	where 1=1 and derive = 0
    and [task_chain_type in (${taskType})]
    and [create_time between (${startTime}::timestamp - interval '1 day') and (${endTime}::timestamp + interval '1 day')]
	order by create_time asc) ts
	on tt.task_chain_code = ts.task_chain_code
where (ts.rn = 1 or ts.rn is null)
    and [tt.create_time between ${startTime} and ${endTime}]
	--任务类型
    and tt.task_chain_type in (${taskType})
    and [ts.rack_flag = ${taskType1} and ts.eqpt_type is null]
	and [ts.rack_flag = ${taskType2} and ts.eqpt_type is null]
	and [ts.eqpt_type = ${taskType3}] 
    and [ts.in_out = ${workType}]
    and [ts.eqpt_code in (${lineCode})]
    and [(ts.end_zone in (${areaCode}) or ts.start_zone in (${areaCode}))]
    and [case when tt.map_code is not null then tt.map_code in (${mapCode}) else ts.map_code in (${mapCode}) end]
    and tt.task_status in ('9')
    and [tt."range" = ${range}]
	) foo1
where 1=1	
	and [foo1.hour_date in (${hour_date})]
    and [foo1.day_date in (${day_date})]
    and [foo1.month_date in (${month_date})]
group by querydate

		first_value(end_zone) over(partition by task_chain_code order by end_zone is not null desc) as end_zone,
		first_value(eqpt_code) over(partition by task_chain_code order by eqpt_code is not null desc) as eqpt_code,
		first_value(eqpt_type) over(partition by task_chain_code order by eqpt_type is not null desc) as eqpt_type,
		case when count(case when (start_slot_category = 'SITE' and sub_task_type = 'MOVE_CARRIER') or (end_slot_category = 'SITE' and sub_task_type = 'MOVE_CARRIER') then 1 end) over (partition by task_chain_code) > 0 then 0 else 1 end as rack_flag,
		min(case when be_interrupted = 0 then 0 else 1 end) over (partition by task_chain_code) as in_out
	from tbl_sub_task 
	where 1=1 and derive = 0
	and [task_chain_type in (${taskType})]
    and [create_time between (${startTime}::timestamp - interval '1 day') and (${endTime}::timestamp + interval '1 day')]
	order by create_time asc) ts
	on tt.task_chain_code = ts.task_chain_code
where (ts.rn = 1 or ts.rn is null)
    and [tt.create_time between ${startTime} and ${endTime}]
	--任务类型
    and tt.task_chain_type in (${taskType})

sources.sourceName: 设备看板-当日地图开动率TOP5
sources.content:
select map_code,case when ("运行"+"空闲"+"异常")=0 then 0 else "运行"/("运行"+"空闲"+"异常") end  as rate from (
select map_code
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='1' then times else 0 END) as "运行"
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='2' then times else 0 END) as "充电"
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='3' then times else 0 END) as "空闲"
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='4' then times else 0 END) as "异常"
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='0' then times else 0 END) as "离线"
from emq_agv_view_001 where "agg_time" >=((date_trunc('day', CURRENT_DATE::TIMESTAMP))::TIMESTAMP)
group by map_code ) t
order by rate desc
 limit 5

select 
	t1.map_name,
	t1.amr_code,
	t1.layer,
	t1.loadtime,
	ROUND(t1.loadtime::numeric / (foo3.total_online_time ::numeric/1000 * t1.layer), 2) AS fullloadrate
from (select dm.map_name, ts.amr_code,case when dat.extend_field_param :: jsonb ->> 'ctuType' = 'STU' then 1 else
	  (dat.extend_field_param :: jsonb->>'layerNum') :: int + (dat.extend_field_param :: jsonb->>'ctuMechCarry') :: int
      end as layer,
	  SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (coalesce(ts.end_time ,ts.update_time) - ts.task_start_time))) AS loadtime
		from tbl_sub_task ts
	  	join dps_sync_amr da on ts.amr_code = da.amr_code 
	  	join dps_sync_amr_type dat on da.type_code = dat.amr_type_code 
	  	join dps_sync_elc_map dm on ts.map_code = dm.map_code
	where 1=1 and dat.amr_category = '40'
	and task_start_time >= ${startTime} 
	and task_start_time <= ${endTime} 
    and [ts.map_code in (${mapCode})]
    and [ts.amr_code in (${amrCode})]
    and [ts."range" = ${range}]
	GROUP by dm.map_name,ts.amr_code,layer) as t1
	join (select amr_code,sum(adjusted_online) as total_online_time 
from (select amr_code,least(extract(EPOCH from (end_overlap - start_overlap)) * 1000, online) as adjusted_online 
	from (select amr_code,agg_time,sum(times) as online,greatest(${startTime}::timestamptz, agg_time) as start_overlap,least(${endTime}::timestamptz, agg_time + interval '30 minutes') as end_overlap
			from emq_agv_view_001
			where 1 = 1 and status2 != '0' and agg_time >= ${startTime}::timestamptz - interval '30 minutes' and agg_time < ${endTime}::timestamptz
			group by amr_code, agg_time) as foo1
	) as foo2
group by amr_code) as foo3
	on t1.amr_code = foo3.amr_code
select generate_series(0, 23, 1)
select distinct lift_code, lift_name from dps_sync_lift

select map_code, count(*)
from (
select task_chain_code,task_chain_type,map_code,case when task_status='10' then '9' else task_status end as task_status from
(SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (partition BY task_chain_code,task_chain_type,map_code ORDER BY update_time desc) rowId,task_chain_code,task_chain_type,map_code,task_status
   from tbl_sub_task
   where  map_code is not null 
  and [task_chain_type in (${taskTypes})]  and [map_code in (${mapcodes})] and [create_time >=${startTime}] and [create_time < ${endTime}] and [range in (${ranges})] 
) t
WHERE rowId=1 and task_status in ('9','10')
) t

select t1.task_chain_type,reply_time,exec_time,eft_time,carrier_lift_time,empty_run_time,count,reply_time/count as avg_reply_time,exec_time/count as avg_exec_time,eft_time/count as avg_eft_time,carrier_lift_time/count as avg_carrier_lift_time,empty_run_time/count as avg_empty_run_time
from 
(
	select task_chain_type
	,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM  sum(CASE WHEN to_char(task_start_time,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')='0001-01-01 00:00:00' or to_char(send_task_time,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')='0001-01-01 00:00:00' then interval '0' else task_start_time-send_task_time end ))/3600  as reply_time
	,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM  sum(CASE WHEN to_char(end_time,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')='0001-01-01 00:00:00' or to_char(send_task_time,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')='0001-01-01 00:00:00' then interval '0' else end_time-send_task_time end ))/3600  as exec_time
	,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM  sum(CASE WHEN to_char(end_time,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')='0001-01-01 00:00:00' or to_char(task_start_time,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')='0001-01-01 00:00:00' then interval '0' else end_time-task_start_time end ))/3600  as eft_time
	,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM  sum(CASE WHEN to_char(load_item_time,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')='0001-01-01 00:00:00' or to_char(create_time,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')='0001-01-01 00:00:00' then interval '0' else load_item_time-create_time end ))/3600  as carrier_lift_time
	,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM  sum(CASE WHEN to_char(load_item_time,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')='0001-01-01 00:00:00' or to_char(create_time,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')='0001-01-01 00:00:00' then interval '0' else load_item_time-task_start_time end ))/3600  as empty_run_time
	from tbl_task
	where [create_time >=${startTime}] and [create_time < ${endTime}] and [range in (${ranges})] and [task_chain_type in (${taskTypes})] and  (task_status='9' or task_status='10') 
	group by task_chain_type
) t1 left join 
(
	select task_chain_type,count(*)  as count from
	(

select sbtime,
case when divide=0 then 0
else round(online_time / divide::numeric)
end as amr_count
from(
select sbtime, online_time,
case when ${sbtype}=1 then 
	case when EXTRACT(HOUR FROM now()) = substring(sbtime, 12)::numeric
	then round(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM now()) * 60 + EXTRACT(SECONDS FROM now()))
	else 3600 end 
when ${sbtype}=2 then 
	case when EXTRACT(DAY FROM now()) = substring(sbtime, 9)::numeric
	then round(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM now()) * 3600 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM now()) * 60 + EXTRACT(SECONDS FROM now()))
	else 86400 end 
end as divide
from(
select round(sum(times)/1000::numeric) as online_time, 
case when ${sbtype}=1 then to_char(agg_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24') --当日,按时间趋势
when ${sbtype}=2 then to_char(agg_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd') --按日期趋势
end as sbtime
from emq_agv_view_001
where 1=1
and [map_code = ${mapcode} ] 
and [agg_time >= ${starttime}] and [agg_time <= ${endtime}]
and status2 <> '0'
group by sbtime
) as foo
) as foo1

select sum("运行"+"空闲"+"异常"+"充电")  as online,d_time  from
(
select SUM (CASE WHEN status2='1' then times else 0 END) as "运行"
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='2' then times else 0 END) as "充电"
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='3' then times else 0 END) as "空闲"
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='4' then times else 0 END) as "异常"
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='0' then times else 0 END) as "离线"
,d_time from (
select amr_code,status2,map_code,range,times,
(CASE 
    WHEN ${dTime1} = '1' THEN to_char(agg_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
    WHEN ${dTime1} = '2' THEN to_char(agg_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24')
    WHEN ${dTime1} = '3' THEN to_char(agg_time, 'yyyy-mm')
END) AS d_time
from emq_agv_view_001
where  [map_code in (${mapcodes})] and [amr_code in (${robotcodes})] and [range in (${ranges})] 
and (CASE 
    WHEN ${dmCase} = '1' THEN (agg_time between date_trunc('week',now()) and current_date+1)
    WHEN ${dmCase} = '2' THEN (agg_time between date_trunc('month',now()) and current_date+1)
    WHEN ${dmCase} = '3' THEN (agg_time between timestamp${_startTime} and timestamp${_endTime})
    ELSE 1=1
END) = true
and (CASE 
    WHEN ${rangeCase1} = '1' THEN (to_char(agg_time,'HH24:MI:SS')::time between time${range_start} and time'24:00:00')
    WHEN ${rangeCase1} = '2' THEN (to_char(agg_time,'HH24:MI:SS')::time between time${range_start} and time${range_end})
    ELSE 1=1
END) = true
) t  group by d_time
union
select SUM (CASE WHEN status2='1' then times else 0 END) as "运行"
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='2' then times else 0 END) as "充电"
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='3' then times else 0 END) as "空闲"
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='4' then times else 0 END) as "异常"
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='0' then times else 0 END) as "离线"
,d_time from (
select amr_code,status2,map_code,range,times,
(CASE 
    WHEN ${dTime2} = '1' THEN to_char(agg_time-interval'1day', 'yyyy-mm-dd')
    WHEN ${dTime2} = '2' THEN to_char(agg_time-interval'1day', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24')
    WHEN ${dTime2} = '3' THEN to_char(agg_time-interval'1day', 'yyyy-mm')
END) AS d_time
from emq_agv_view_001 
where  [map_code in (${mapcodes})] and [amr_code in (${robotcodes})] and [range in (${ranges})] 
and (CASE 
    WHEN ${dmCase} = '1' THEN (agg_time between date_trunc('week',now()) and current_date+1)
    WHEN ${dmCase} = '2' THEN (agg_time between date_trunc('month',now()) and current_date+1)
    WHEN ${dmCase} = '3' THEN (agg_time between timestamp${_startTime} and timestamp${_endTime})
    ELSE 1=1
END) = true  
and (CASE 
    WHEN ${rangeCase2} = '1' THEN (to_char(agg_time,'HH24:MI:SS')::time between time'00:00:00' and time${range_end})
    WHEN ${rangeCase2} = '2' THEN (1=2)
    ELSE 1=1
END) = true
) t  group by d_time
) s group by d_time order by d_time

select map_code as mapcode,case when "运行"=0 then 0 else "运行"/("运行"+"空闲"+"异常") end as rate  from
(
select map_code
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='1' then times else 0 END) as "运行"
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='2' then times else 0 END) as "充电"
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='3' then times else 0 END) as "空闲"
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='4' then times else 0 END) as "异常"
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='0' then times else 0 END) as "离线"
from emq_agv_view_001 
where [map_code in (${mapcodes})] and ([agg_time >=${startTime}] and [agg_time < ${endTime}] or agg_time between current_date-1 and current_timestamp)
and [range in (${ranges})]
group by map_code 
) t
order by rate  desc

select map_code, count(*)
from (
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (partition BY ts.task_chain_code ORDER BY ts.update_time desc) rowId,
 ts.map_code, ts.task_status
   from tbl_sub_task ts
   left join tbl_task tc on tc.task_chain_code = ts.task_chain_code
   where  tc.task_status = '9'
   and [case when tc.task_biz_type is not null and tc.task_biz_type <> '' then tc.task_biz_type in (${tasktypes}) else tc.task_chain_type in (${tasktypes}) end]
   and [ts.create_time >=${starttime}] and [ts.create_time < ${endtime}] 
   and [tc.create_time >=${starttime}] and [tc.create_time < ${endtime}] 
   and [ts."range" in (${range})] 
) foo
WHERE rowId=1 
and [map_code in (${mapcodes})] and task_status in ('9','10','11') 
group by map_code
order by count desc

select charge_code, timer.d_time, "scale"
from (
select concat(coo_x, '-', coo_y, '-', map_code) as charge_code, d_time, 
 100 - round((sum(chargesuccess)*100)/count(1)::numeric) as "scale"
from (
select coo_x, coo_y, map_code, 
case when substring(${starttime}, 12, 2)::numeric <= substring(${endtime}, 12, 2)::numeric 
   			 or task_start_time::time >= substring(${endtime}, 12)::time
 or ${selrange} = 0 then to_char(task_start_time,'yyyy-mm-dd') 
   		else to_char((task_start_time - interval '1days'),'yyyy-mm-dd')	-- 跨天夜班,需要将第二天凌晨的数据统计到前一天,通过修改日期的方式
   		end as d_time,
case when extract (EPOCH FROM (charge_finish_time - charge_start_time)) < 180 then 0 --充电时长<3min
	 when extract (EPOCH FROM (charge_finish_time - charge_start_time)) >= 180 
		and (cast(finish_battery as numeric) - cast(start_battery as numeric)) <= 0 then 0  -- 充电时长3分钟且电量未增长
	 else 1 
end as chargeSuccess 
from tbl_charge_task 
where charge_start_time is not null and charge_start_time > '0001-01-01 00:00:00'
and charge_finish_time is not null and charge_finish_time > '0001-01-01 00:00:00'
and [task_start_time >= ${starttime}] and [task_start_time <= ${endtime}]
and ["range" = ${range}] and [map_code in (${mapcodes})] and [amr_code = ${amrcode}] 
and [concat(coo_x, '-', coo_y, '-', map_code) in (${chargers})]
) as foo group by coo_x, coo_y, map_code, d_time
) as charge
right join
(
select to_char(generate_series(to_date(start_time,'yyyy-mm-dd'), end_time, '1day'),'yyyy-mm-dd') as d_time
from (
SELECT ${starttime} as start_time,
		case when substring(${starttime}, 12, 2)::numeric <= substring(${endtime}, 12, 2)::numeric 
			or ${selrange} = 0 then ${endtime}
	   else (to_date(${endtime},'yyyy-mm-dd') - interval '1days')::date	-- 跨天夜班,需要将最后一天的日期去掉,数据已落在前一天里
	   end as end_time
) as foo3
) as timer on charge.d_time=timer.d_time
order by d_time,charge_code

select b.amr_code, b.map_code, b.battery, c.success,
case when c."scale" is null then '未充电' else c."scale" end as "scale"
from (
select round(sum(battery2)/count(1)::numeric) as battery, amr_code, map_code
from emq_agv_status_view_001 where [map_code in (${mapcodes})]
and battery2 >= 0 and battery2 <= 100
--and "timestamp" = (select max("timestamp") from emq_agv_status_view_001)
and status2 <> '0'
group by amr_code, map_code
) as b
left join (
select amr_code, concat(round((success*100)/counts::numeric), '(', success, '/', counts, ')') as "scale",
round((success*100)/counts::numeric) as success
from (
select count(1) as counts, sum(chargesuccess) as success, amr_code
from (
select amr_code,
case when extract (EPOCH FROM (charge_finish_time - charge_start_time)) < 180 then 0 --充电时长<3min
	 when extract (EPOCH FROM (charge_finish_time - charge_start_time)) >= 180 
		and (cast(finish_battery as numeric) - cast(start_battery as numeric)) <= 0 then 0  -- 充电时长3分钟且电量未增长
	 else 1 
end as chargeSuccess 
from tbl_charge_task 
where charge_start_time is not null and charge_start_time > '0001-01-01 00:00:00'
and charge_finish_time is not null and charge_finish_time > '0001-01-01 00:00:00'
and [map_code in (${mapcodes})]
and [task_start_time >=${starttime}]  and [task_start_time <= ${endtime}]
and ["range" = ${range}]
) as foo group by amr_code
) as foo2 order by "scale"
) as c on c.amr_code = b.amr_code
order by success asc, battery asc

select coox, cooy, sum(counts) as counts from (
select start_x as coox, start_y as cooy, count(1) as counts from tbl_sub_task 
where start_x is not null and end_x is not null 
and task_status = '9'
and [create_time >= ${starttime}] and [create_time <= ${endtime}]
and [map_code = ${mapcode}]
and [range = ${range}]
group by coox, cooy
union all
select end_x as coox, end_y as cooy, count(1) as counts from tbl_sub_task 
where end_x is not null and end_y is not null 
and task_status = '9'
and [create_time >= ${starttime}] and [create_time <= ${endtime}]
and [map_code = ${mapcode}]
and [range = ${range}]
group by coox, cooy
)as foo group by coox, cooy

sources.sourceName: 看板-获取时间查询范围
sources.content:
select * 
from (
select 
	case when range_time_start < range_time_end then
		case when ${type}='day' then to_char(current_date + range_time_start, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
	 	when ${type}='week' then concat(to_char(weekstart, 'yyyy-mm-dd'), ' ', to_char(range_time_start, 'hh24:mi:ss'))
	 	when ${type}='month' then concat(to_char(monthstart, 'yyyy-mm-dd'), ' ', to_char(range_time_start, 'hh24:mi:ss'))
	 	else null
		end
	else 
		case when ${type}='day' then 
			case when spanday = interval '-1days' then concat(to_char(current_date + spanday, 'yyyy-mm-dd'), ' ', to_char(range_time_start, 'hh24:mi:ss'))
			else to_char(current_date + range_time_start, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') end	-- 计算夜班起始
		when ${type}='week' then
			case when current_date = weekstart and current_time < range_time_end 
				then concat(to_char(weekstart + interval '-1days', 'yyyy-mm-dd'), ' ', to_char(range_time_start, 'hh24:mi:ss'))-- 首周第一天，还在前一天的夜班
			else concat(to_char(weekstart, 'yyyy-mm-dd'), ' ', to_char(range_time_start, 'hh24:mi:ss')) end
		when ${type}='month' then
			case when current_date = monthstart and current_time < range_time_end 
				then concat(to_char(monthstart + interval '-1days', 'yyyy-mm-dd'), ' ', to_char(range_time_start, 'hh24:mi:ss'))-- 首月第一天，还在前一天的夜班
			else concat(to_char(monthstart, 'yyyy-mm-dd'), ' ', to_char(range_time_start, 'hh24:mi:ss')) end
		else null 
		end
	end as start_time,
	
	case when range_time_start < range_time_end then
		case when ${type}='day' then to_char(current_date + range_time_end, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
		when ${type}='week' then concat(to_char(weekend, 'yyyy-mm-dd'), ' ', to_char(range_time_end, 'hh24:mi:ss'))
		when ${type}='month' then concat(to_char(monthend, 'yyyy-mm-dd'), ' ', to_char(range_time_end, 'hh24:mi:ss'))
		else null
		end
	else 
		case when ${type}='day' then
			case when spanday = interval '1days' then concat(to_char(current_date + spanday, 'yyyy-mm-dd'), ' ', to_char(range_time_end, 'hh24:mi:ss'))
			else to_char(current_date + range_time_end, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') end	-- 计算夜班终止
		when ${type}='week' then concat(to_char(weekend, 'yyyy-mm-dd'), ' ', '23:59:59')
		when ${type}='month' then concat(to_char(monthend, 'yyyy-mm-dd'), ' ', '23:59:59')
		else null 
		end
	end as end_time

select id,name,range_start,range_end,range_time_start,range_time_end, case when range_time_start>range_time_end then '>' else '<' end as cmp  from 
(
select id,name,date(now())+range_time_start as range_start,date(now())+range_time_end as range_end,range_time_start,range_time_end 
from dps_work_range where range_time_start <range_time_end
union
select id,name,date(now())+range_time_start as range_start,date(now()+interval'1day')+range_time_end as range_end,range_time_start,range_time_end

union

    WHEN ${dTime1} = '3' THEN to_char(agg_time, 'yyyy-mm')
END) as d_time 
from emq_agv_view_001
where  [map_code in (${mapcodes})] and [amr_code in (${robotcodes})] and [range in (${ranges})] 
and (CASE
    WHEN ${paramCase}='1' THEN (agg_time between date_trunc('week',now()) and current_date+1)
    WHEN ${paramCase}='2' THEN (agg_time between date_trunc('month',now()) and current_date+1)
    WHEN ${paramCase}='3' THEN (agg_time between timestamp${_startTime} and timestamp${_endTime})
    WHEN ${paramCase}='4' THEN (agg_time>= timestamp${_startTime} and agg_time < timestamp${_endTime})
    ELSE 1=1
END) = true 
and (CASE
    WHEN ${rangeCase1}='1' THEN (to_char(agg_time,'HH24:MI:SS')::time between time${range_start} and time'24:00:00')
    WHEN ${rangeCase1}='2' THEN (to_char(agg_time,'HH24:MI:SS')::time between time${range_start} and time${range_end})
    WHEN ${rangeCase1}='3' THEN (to_char(agg_time,'HH24:MI:SS')::time>= time${range_start} and to_char(agg_time,'HH24:MI:SS')::time < time'24:00:00')
    WHEN ${rangeCase1}='4' THEN (to_char(agg_time,'HH24:MI:SS')::time >= time${range_start} and to_char(agg_time,'HH24:MI:SS')::time < time${range_end})
    ELSE 1=1
END) = true
) t  group by d_time
union
select SUM (CASE WHEN status2='1' then times else 0 END) as "运行"
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='2' then times else 0 END) as "充电"
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='3' then times else 0 END) as "空闲"
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='4' then times else 0 END) as "异常"
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='0' then times else 0 END) as "离线"
,d_time from (
select amr_code,status2,map_code,range,times,
(CASE
    WHEN ${dTime2} = '1' THEN to_char(agg_time-interval'1day', 'yyyy-mm-dd')
    WHEN ${dTime2} = '2' THEN to_char(agg_time-interval'1day', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24')
    WHEN ${dTime2} = '3' THEN to_char(agg_time-interval'1day', 'yyyy-mm')
    WHEN ${dTime2} = '4' THEN to_char(agg_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24')
END) as d_time 
from emq_agv_view_001
where  [map_code in (${mapcodes})] and [amr_code in (${robotcodes})] and [range in (${ranges})]  
and (CASE
    WHEN ${paramCase}='1' THEN (agg_time between date_trunc('week',now()) and current_date+1)
    WHEN ${paramCase}='2' THEN (agg_time between date_trunc('month',now()) and current_date+1)
    WHEN ${paramCase}='3' THEN (agg_time between timestamp${_startTime} and timestamp${_endTime})
    WHEN ${paramCase}='4' THEN (agg_time>= timestamp${_startTime} and agg_time < timestamp${_endTime})
    ELSE 1=1
END) = true 
and (CASE
    WHEN ${rangeCase2}='1' THEN (to_char(agg_time,'HH24:MI:SS')::time between time'00:00:00' and time${range_end})
    WHEN ${rangeCase2}='2' THEN (1=2)
    WHEN ${rangeCase2}='3' THEN (to_char(agg_time,'HH24:MI:SS')::time>= time'00:00:00' and to_char(agg_time,'HH24:MI:SS')::time< time${range_end})
    ELSE 1=1
END) = true
) t  group by d_time
) s group by d_time order by d_time asc

select timer.d_time, counts, task_chain_type
from (
select count(1) as counts, task_chain_type, d_time
from (
select row_number() over(partition by ts.task_chain_code order by ts.update_time desc nulls last) as row_num, 
ts.task_status, 
case when tc.task_biz_type is not null and tc.task_biz_type <> '' then tc.task_biz_type else tc.task_chain_type end as task_chain_type, 
case when substring(${starttime}, 12, 2)::numeric <= substring(${endtime}, 12, 2)::numeric 
   		  or ts.create_time::time >= substring(${endtime}, 12)::time
		  or ${selrange} = 0 
		  then to_char(ts.create_time,'yyyy-mm-dd') 
   	 else to_char((ts.create_time - interval '1days'),'yyyy-mm-dd')	-- 跨天夜班,需要将第二天凌晨的数据统计到前一天,通过修改日期的方式
end as d_time
from tbl_sub_task ts
left join tbl_task tc on tc.task_chain_code = ts.task_chain_code
where tc.task_status = '9'
and [case when tc.task_biz_type is not null and tc.task_biz_type <> '' then tc.task_biz_type in (${tasktypes}) else tc.task_chain_type in (${tasktypes}) end] 
and [ts."range" = ${range}]
and [ts.create_time >= ${starttime}] and [ts.create_time <= ${endtime}]
and [tc.create_time >= ${starttime}] and [tc.create_time <= ${endtime}]
) as foo where row_num = 1 
group by task_chain_type, d_time
) as task
right join
(
select to_char(generate_series(to_date(start_time,'yyyy-mm-dd'), end_time, '1day'),'yyyy-mm-dd') as d_time
from (
SELECT ${starttime} as start_time,
case when substring(${starttime}, 12, 2)::numeric <= substring(${endtime}, 12, 2)::numeric 
		  or ${selrange} = 0 
		  then ${endtime}
	 else (to_date(${endtime},'yyyy-mm-dd') - interval '1days')::date	-- 跨天夜班,需要将最后一天的日期去掉,数据已落在前一天里
end as end_time
) as foo3
) as timer on task.d_time=timer.d_time
order by d_time,task_chain_type
SELECT to_char(generate_series(to_date(${starttime},'yyyy-mm'), to_date(${endtime},'yyyy-mm'), '1month'),'yyyy-mm') as d_time

round(sum(battery)::numeric/count(1), 2) as avg_battery 
from (
select row_num, task_chain_type, execute_time as execute_time, 
sum(produce_time) over(partition by task_chain_code) as produce_time,
sum(allot_time) over(partition by task_chain_code) as allot_time, 
sum(dispatch_time) over(partition by task_chain_code) as dispatch_time, 
sum(work_time) over(partition by task_chain_code) as work_time,
sum(remove_carrier_time) over(partition by task_chain_code) as remove_carrier_time, 
sum(mileage) over(partition by task_chain_code) as mileage, 
sum(battery) over(partition by task_chain_code) as battery
from (
select row_number() over(partition by ts.task_chain_code order by ts.update_time desc nulls last) as row_num, 
case when tc.task_biz_type is not null and tc.task_biz_type <> '' then tc.task_biz_type else tc.task_chain_type end as task_chain_type, 
ts.task_chain_code,
round(extract(EPOCH FROM (tc.end_time - tc.create_time))::numeric/60, 2) as execute_time,
case when ts.send_task_time is not null and ts.send_task_time > '0001-01-01 00:00:00' 
and ts.send_task_time >= ts.create_time then 
round(extract(EPOCH FROM (ts.send_task_time - ts.create_time))::numeric / 60 , 2) else null end as produce_time,
case when ts.send_task_time is not null and ts.send_task_time > '0001-01-01 00:00:00'
and ts.task_start_time is not null and ts.task_start_time > '0001-01-01 00:00:00' 
and ts.task_start_time >= ts.send_task_time then 
round(extract(EPOCH FROM (ts.task_start_time - ts.send_task_time))::numeric / 60 , 2) else null end as allot_time,
case when ts.task_start_time is not null and ts.task_start_time > '0001-01-01 00:00:00'
and ts.load_item_time is not null and ts.load_item_time > '0001-01-01 00:00:00' 
and ts.load_item_time >= ts.task_start_time then 
round(extract(EPOCH FROM (ts.load_item_time - ts.task_start_time))::numeric / 60 , 2) else null end as dispatch_time,
case when ts.end_time is not null and ts.end_time > '0001-01-01 00:00:00'
and ts.load_item_time is not null and ts.load_item_time > '0001-01-01 00:00:00' 
and ts.end_time >= ts.load_item_time then 
round(extract(EPOCH FROM (ts.end_time - ts.load_item_time))::numeric / 60 , 2) else null end as work_time,
case when ts.load_item_time is not null and ts.load_item_time > '0001-01-01 00:00:00' 
and ts.load_item_time >= ts.create_time then 
round(extract(EPOCH FROM (ts.load_item_time - ts.create_time))::numeric / 60 , 2) else null end as remove_carrier_time,
case when ts.start_mileage is not null and ts.start_mileage <> ''
and ts.end_mileage is not null and ts.end_mileage <> '' 
and cast(ts.end_mileage as numeric) >= cast(ts.start_mileage as numeric) then 
cast(ts.end_mileage as numeric) - cast(ts.start_mileage as numeric) else null end as mileage,
case when ts.start_battery is not null and ts.start_battery <> ''
and ts.end_battery is not null and ts.end_battery <> ''
and cast(ts.start_battery as numeric) >= cast(ts.end_battery as numeric) then 
cast(ts.start_battery as numeric) - cast(ts.end_battery as numeric) else null end as battery
from tbl_sub_task ts
left join 
tbl_task tc on tc.task_chain_code = ts.task_chain_code
where tc.task_status = '9'
and tc.end_time is not null and tc.end_time > '0001-01-01 00:00:00' and tc.create_time is not null and tc.create_time > '0001-01-01 00:00:00'
and [case when tc.task_biz_type is not null then tc.task_biz_type in (${tasktypes}) else tc.task_chain_type in (${tasktypes}) end] 
and [ts."range" = ${range}]
and [ts.create_time >= ${starttime}] and [ts.create_time <= ${endtime}]
and [tc.create_time >= ${starttime}] and [tc.create_time <= ${endtime}]
) as foo 
) as main
where row_num = 1
group by task_chain_type

select avg_time, task_chain_type, timer.d_time 
from (
select round(sum(times)::numeric/count(1), 2) as avg_time, task_chain_type, d_time
from (
select task.task_chain_code, task_chain_type, task.d_time, times
from (
select row_num, task_status, task_chain_code, task_chain_type, d_time
from (
select row_number() over(partition by ts.task_chain_code order by ts.update_time desc nulls last) as row_num, 
ts.task_status, 
case when tc.task_biz_type is not null and tc.task_biz_type <> '' then tc.task_biz_type else tc.task_chain_type end as task_chain_type, 
ts.task_chain_code,
case when substring(${starttime}, 12, 2)::numeric <= substring(${endtime}, 12, 2)::numeric 
   		  or ts.create_time::time >= substring(${endtime}, 12)::time
		  or ${selrange} = 0 
		  then to_char(ts.create_time,'yyyy-mm-dd') 
   	 else to_char((ts.create_time - interval '1days'),'yyyy-mm-dd')	-- 跨天夜班,需要将第二天凌晨的数据统计到前一天,通过修改日期的方式
end as d_time
from tbl_sub_task ts
left join tbl_task tc on tc.task_chain_code = ts.task_chain_code
where tc.task_status = '9'
and [case when tc.task_biz_type is not null and tc.task_biz_type <> '' then tc.task_biz_type in (${tasktypes}) else tc.task_chain_type in (${tasktypes}) end] 
and [ts."range" = ${range}]
and [ts.create_time >= ${starttime}] and [ts.create_time <= ${endtime}]
and [tc.create_time >= ${starttime}] and [tc.create_time <= ${endtime}]
) as foo where row_num = 1 
) as task
left join 
(
select avg(times) as times, task_chain_code, d_time
from (
select round(sum(extract(EPOCH FROM (${time1} - ${time2}))) over (partition by task_chain_code)::numeric / 60 , 2) as times,
task_chain_code, 
case when substring(${starttime}, 12, 2)::numeric <= substring(${endtime}, 12, 2)::numeric 
   		  or create_time::time >= substring(${endtime}, 12)::time
		  or ${selrange} = 0 
		  then to_char(create_time,'yyyy-mm-dd') 
   	 else to_char((create_time - interval '1days'),'yyyy-mm-dd')	-- 跨天夜班,需要将第二天凌晨的数据统计到前一天,通过修改日期的方式
end as d_time
from tbl_sub_task where ${time1} is not null and ${time1} > '0001-01-01 00:00:00'
and ${time2} is not null and ${time2} > '0001-01-01 00:00:00'
and ["range" = ${range}]
and [create_time >= ${starttime}] and [create_time <= ${endtime}]
) as foo group by task_chain_code, d_time
) as timer on timer.task_chain_code = task.task_chain_code and timer.d_time = task.d_time
) as foo2 group by task_chain_type, d_time
) as main
right join
(
select to_char(generate_series(to_date(start_time,'yyyy-mm-dd'), end_time, '1day'),'yyyy-mm-dd') as d_time
from (
SELECT ${starttime} as start_time,
case when substring(${starttime}, 12, 2)::numeric <= substring(${endtime}, 12, 2)::numeric 
		  or ${selrange} = 0 
		  then ${endtime}
	 else (to_date(${endtime},'yyyy-mm-dd') - interval '1days')::date	-- 跨天夜班,需要将最后一天的日期去掉,数据已落在前一天里
end as end_time
) as foo3
) as timer on main.d_time=timer.d_time
order by d_time,task_chain_type

select case when ("运行"+"充电")=0 then 0 else ("运行"+"充电")/("运行"+"充电"+"空闲"+"异常") end  as rate from (
select SUM (CASE WHEN status2='1' then times else 0 END) as "运行"
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='2' then times else 0 END) as "充电"
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='3' then times else 0 END) as "空闲"
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='4' then times else 0 END) as "异常"
,SUM (CASE WHEN status2='0' then times else 0 END) as "离线"
from emq_agv_view_001 where "agg_time" >=to_timestamp(${time_start},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') 
and "agg_time"<to_timestamp(${time_end},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') and (CASE
    WHEN ${paramCase} = '1' THEN ((to_char(agg_time,'HH24:MI:SS')::time >= time${range_time_start} and to_char(agg_time,'HH24:MI:SS')::time < time'23:59:59') or (to_char(agg_time,'HH24:MI:SS')::time >= time'00:00:00' and to_char(agg_time,'HH24:MI:SS')::time < time${range_time_end}))
    WHEN ${paramCase} = '2' THEN (to_char(agg_time,'HH24:MI:SS')::time >= time${range_time_start} and to_char(agg_time,'HH24:MI:SS')::time < time${range_time_end})
    ELSE 1=1
END) = true    
and (CASE
    WHEN ${psCase} = '1' THEN (to_char(agg_time,'HH24:MI:SS')::time >= time${range_time_start} and to_char(agg_time,'HH24:MI:SS')::time < time'24:00:00' or to_char(agg_time,'HH24:MI:SS')::time >= time${range_time_start} and to_char(agg_time,'HH24:MI:SS')::time < time${range_hour})
    WHEN ${psCase} = '2' THEN (to_char(agg_time,'HH24:MI:SS')::time >= time${range_time_start} and to_char(agg_time,'HH24:MI:SS')::time < time${range_hour})
    ELSE 1=1
END) = true
and [map_code in (${mapcodes})]
) t order by rate desc

from (
select count(1) as counts, task_chain_type, d_time
from (

ts.task_status, 
case when tc.task_biz_type is not null and tc.task_biz_type <> '' then tc.task_biz_type else tc.task_chain_type end as task_chain_type, 
to_char(ts.create_time,'yyyy-mm') as d_time
from tbl_sub_task ts
left join tbl_task tc on tc.task_chain_code = ts.task_chain_code
where tc.task_status = '9'
and [case when tc.task_biz_type is not null and tc.task_biz_type <> '' then tc.task_biz_type in (${tasktypes}) else tc.task_chain_type in (${tasktypes}) end] 
and [ts."range" = ${range}]
and [ts.create_time >= ${starttime}] and [ts.create_time <= ${endtime}]
and [tc.create_time >= ${starttime}] and [tc.create_time <= ${endtime}]
) as foo where row_num = 1 
group by task_chain_type, d_time
) as task

(
SELECT to_char(generate_series(to_date(${starttime},'yyyy-mm'), to_date(${endtime},'yyyy-mm'),'1month'),'yyyy-mm') as d_time
) as timer on task.d_time=timer.d_time
order by d_time,task_chain_type

select round((task_time::numeric/counts)/60::numeric, 1) as avg_task_time, 
round((exec_time/task_time)*100::numeric) as exec_scale, task_type
from (
select count(1) as counts, sum(exec_time) as exec_time, sum(task_time) as task_time, task_chain_type as task_type
from (
select row_number() over (partition by ts.task_chain_code order by ts.update_time desc nulls last) as row_num, 
case when ts.end_time is not null and ts.end_time > '0001-01-01 00:00:00' and ts.load_item_time is not null and ts.load_item_time > '0001-01-01 00:00:00' then 
SUM(EXTRACT (EPOCH FROM (ts.end_time - ts.load_item_time))) over (partition by ts.task_chain_code) 
else null end as exec_time, 
ts.task_chain_code, 
case when tc.task_biz_type is not null then tc.task_biz_type else tc.task_chain_type end as task_chain_type, 
ts.task_status, ts.map_code,
EXTRACT (EPOCH FROM (tc.end_time - tc.create_time)) as task_time 
from tbl_sub_task as ts
left join tbl_task tc on tc.task_chain_code = ts.task_chain_code
where tc.end_time is not null and tc.end_time > '0001-01-01 00:00:00' and tc.create_time is not null and tc.create_time > '0001-01-01 00:00:00'
and [ts.create_time >= ${starttime}] and [ts.create_time <= ${endtime}]
and [tc.create_time >= ${starttime}] and [tc.create_time <= ${endtime}]
and [ts."range" = ${range}]
and tc.task_status = '9' 
) as foo
where row_num = 1 and task_status in ('9','10','11')
and [map_code in (${mapcodes})]
group by task_chain_type
) as foo2
order by exec_scale asc

case when extract (EPOCH FROM (charge_finish_time - charge_start_time)) < 180 then 0 --充电时长<3min
	 when extract (EPOCH FROM (charge_finish_time - charge_start_time)) >= 180

	 else 1 
end as success 
from tbl_charge_task 
where charge_start_time is not null and charge_start_time > '0001-01-01 00:00:00'
and charge_finish_time is not null and charge_finish_time > '0001-01-01 00:00:00'
and [task_start_time >= ${starttime}] and [task_start_time <= ${endtime}]

left join 
(
select round((charge_time * 100)::numeric / extract (EPOCH FROM (end_time - start_time))::numeric, 2) as charge_use,
charge_code2
from (
select concat(coo_x, '-', coo_y, '-', map_code) as charge_code2,
sum(extract (EPOCH FROM (charge_finish_time - charge_start_time))) as charge_time,
case when now() < to_timestamp(${endtime}, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') then now()
else to_timestamp(${endtime}, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
end as end_time,
to_timestamp(${starttime}, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as start_time
from tbl_charge_task
where charge_start_time is not null and charge_start_time > '0001-01-01 00:00:00'
and charge_finish_time is not null and charge_finish_time > '0001-01-01 00:00:00'
and [task_start_time >= ${starttime}] and [task_start_time <= ${endtime}]
and [map_code in (${mapcodes})]
and [amr_code = ${amrcode}]
and [concat(coo_x, '-', coo_y, '-', map_code) in (${chargers})]
group by concat(coo_x, '-', coo_y, '-', map_code)
) as foo
) as f2 on f2.charge_code2 = f1.charge_code

select avg_time, task_chain_type, timer.d_time 
from (
select round((sum(execute_time)::numeric)::numeric/count(1), 2)  as avg_time, task_chain_type, d_time
from (
select row_num, task_status, task_chain_code, task_chain_type, d_time, execute_time 
from (
select row_number() over(partition by ts.task_chain_code order by ts.update_time desc nulls last) as row_num, 
ts.task_status, ts.task_chain_code, 
case when tc.task_biz_type is not null and tc.task_biz_type <> '' then tc.task_biz_type else tc.task_chain_type end as task_chain_type, 
to_char(ts.create_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24') as d_time,
round(extract(EPOCH FROM (tc.end_time - tc.create_time))::numeric / 60, 2) as execute_time
from tbl_sub_task ts
left join tbl_task tc on tc.task_chain_code = ts.task_chain_code
where tc.task_status = '9'
and [case when tc.task_biz_type is not null and tc.task_biz_type <> '' then tc.task_biz_type in (${tasktypes}) else tc.task_chain_type in (${tasktypes}) end] 
and [ts."range" = ${range}]
and [ts.create_time >= ${starttime}] and [ts.create_time <= ${endtime}]
and [tc.create_time >= ${starttime}] and [tc.create_time <= ${endtime}]
) as foo where row_num = 1 
) as foo2 group by task_chain_type, d_time
) as main
right join
(
SELECT to_char(generate_series(to_timestamp(${starttime},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss'), to_timestamp(${endtime},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss'), '1hours'),'yyyy-mm-dd hh24') as d_time
) as timer on main.d_time=timer.d_time
order by d_time,task_chain_type

sources.content:
select avg_time, task_chain_type, timer.d_time 
from (
select round((sum(execute_time)::numeric)::numeric/count(1), 2)  as avg_time, task_chain_type, d_time
from (
select row_num, task_status, task_chain_code, task_chain_type, d_time, execute_time 
from (
select row_number() over(partition by ts.task_chain_code order by ts.update_time desc nulls last) as row_num, 
ts.task_status, 
case when tc.task_biz_type is not null and tc.task_biz_type <> '' then tc.task_biz_type else tc.task_chain_type end as task_chain_type, 
ts.task_chain_code,
case when substring(${starttime}, 12, 2)::numeric <= substring(${endtime}, 12, 2)::numeric 
   		  or ts.create_time::time >= substring(${endtime}, 12)::time
		  or ${selrange} = 0 
		  then to_char(ts.create_time,'yyyy-mm-dd') 
   	 else to_char((ts.create_time - interval '1days'),'yyyy-mm-dd')	-- 跨天夜班,需要将第二天凌晨的数据统计到前一天,通过修改日期的方式
end as d_time,
round(extract(EPOCH FROM (tc.end_time - tc.create_time))::numeric / 60, 2) as execute_time
from tbl_sub_task ts
left join tbl_task tc on tc.task_chain_code = ts.task_chain_code
where tc.task_status = '9'
and [case when tc.task_biz_type is not null and tc.task_biz_type <> '' then tc.task_biz_type in (${tasktypes}) else tc.task_chain_type in (${tasktypes}) end] 
and [ts."range" = ${range}]
and [ts.create_time >= ${starttime}] and [ts.create_time <= ${endtime}]
and [tc.create_time >= ${starttime}] and [tc.create_time <= ${endtime}]
) as foo where row_num = 1 
) as foo2 group by task_chain_type, d_time
) as main
right join
(
select to_char(generate_series(to_date(start_time,'yyyy-mm-dd'), end_time, '1day'),'yyyy-mm-dd') as d_time
from (
SELECT ${starttime} as start_time,
case when substring(${starttime}, 12, 2)::numeric <= substring(${endtime}, 12, 2)::numeric 
	  	  or ${selrange} = 0 
	  	  then ${endtime}
	 else (to_date(${endtime},'yyyy-mm-dd') - interval '1days')::date	-- 跨天夜班,需要将最后一天的日期去掉,数据已落在前一天里
end as end_time
) as foo3
) as timer on main.d_time=timer.d_time
order by d_time,task_chain_type

select f3.disabled_c + f3.is_empty_c + f3.is_full_c + f3.wait_out_c + f3.wait_in_c as all_count_c,
f3.*, ce.map_name, cc."name"
from (
	select channel_code, map_code,
	max(case when status = 'task_empty_n' then counts else 0 end) as task_empty_n,
	max(case when status = 'is_empty_n' then counts else 0 end) as is_empty_n,
	max(case when status = 'task_full_n' then counts else 0 end) as task_full_n,
	max(case when status = 'is_full_n' then counts else 0 end) as is_full_n,
	max(case when status = 'disabled_c' then counts else 0 end) as disabled_c,   
	max(case when status = 'is_empty_c' then counts else 0 end) as is_empty_c,   
	max(case when status = 'is_full_c' then counts else 0 end) as is_full_c,   
	max(case when status = 'wait_out_c' then counts else 0 end) as wait_out_c, 
	max(case when status = 'wait_in_c' then counts else 0 end) as wait_in_c,   
	max(case when status = 'task_out_c' then counts else 0 end) as task_out_c,   
	max(case when status = 'task_in_c' then counts else 0 end) as task_in_c    
	from (
		select channel_code, status, count(1) as counts, map_code
		from (
			select cb.channel_code, cb.map_code, cb.bin_code, 
			case when cb.mrta_select = 0 then  -- 普通仓位
				case when tb.out_capacity = 0 and locked_out_capacity = 0 and tb.locked_in_capacity > 0 then 'task_empty_n'
				when tb.out_capacity = 0 and locked_out_capacity = 0 and tb.locked_in_capacity = 0 then 'is_empty_n'
				when tb.in_capacity = 0 and locked_in_capacity = 0 and tb.locked_out_capacity > 0 then 'task_full_n'
				when tb.in_capacity = 0 and locked_in_capacity = 0 and tb.locked_out_capacity = 0 then 'is_full_n' else '' end
			else  -- 缓存仓位
				case when cb.enable_flag = 0 then 'disabled_c'
				when tb.locked_out_capacity = 0 and tb.out_capacity = 0 then 'is_empty_c'
				when tb.locked_out_capacity = 0 and tb.in_capacity = 0 then 'is_full_c'
				when tb.locked_out_capacity > 0 and (tst.sub_task_gen_param::json -> 'interrupt')::text = '0' then 'wait_out_c'
				when tb.locked_out_capacity > 0 and (tst.sub_task_gen_param::json -> 'interrupt')::text = '1' then 'wait_in_c' else '' end 
			end as status
			from cms_bin cb 
			left join tas_bin_status tb on cb.bin_code = tb.bin_code
			left join tas_slot_layer tsl on tb.bin_code = tsl.slot_code
			left join tas_sub_task tst on tsl.sub_lock_source = tst.sub_task_code
			where cb.channel_code is not null and cb.channel_code <> ''
			and [cb.map_code = ${mapCode}]
			and [cb.channel_code = ${channelCode}]
			union all
			select cb.channel_code, cb.map_code, cb.bin_code,
			case when (ts.sub_task_gen_param::json -> 'interrupt')::text = '0' then 'task_out_c'
			when (ts.sub_task_gen_param::json -> 'interrupt')::text = '1' then 'task_in_c' 
			end as status
			from tas_sub_task ts
			left join cms_bin cb on ts.end_slot_code = cb.bin_code
			where ts.end_slot_category = 'BIN' and ts.task_status not in ('5', '7', '9', '10', '11')
			and cb.mrta_select = 1 and cb.channel_code is not null and cb.channel_code <> ''
			and [cb.map_code = ${mapCode}]
			and [cb.channel_code = ${channelCode}]
		) as f group by channel_code, status, map_code
	) as f2 group by channel_code, map_code
) as f3 left join cms_elc_map ce on f3.map_code = ce.map_code
left join cms_channel cc on f3.channel_code = cc.code
order by f3.map_code, f3.channel_code

sources.sourceName: 获取仓位出入库空满数
sources.content:
select f3.*, ce.map_name
from (
select
channel_code, map_code,
max(case when status = 'task_empty' then counts else 0 end) as task_empty,   --用max取最大的
max(case when status = 'is_empty' then counts else 0 end) as is_empty,
max(case when status = 'task_full' then counts else 0 end) as task_full,
max(case when status = 'is_full' then counts else 0 end) as is_full  
from (
select channel_code, status, count(1) as counts, map_code
from (
select cb.channel_code, cb.map_code, 
case when tb.out_capacity = 0 and locked_out_capacity = 0 and tb.locked_in_capacity > 0 then 'task_empty'
when tb.out_capacity = 0 and locked_out_capacity = 0 and tb.locked_in_capacity = 0 then 'is_empty'
when tb.in_capacity = 0 and locked_in_capacity = 0 and tb.locked_out_capacity > 0 then 'task_full'
when tb.in_capacity = 0 and locked_in_capacity = 0 and tb.locked_out_capacity = 0 then 'is_full'
end as status
from cms_bin cb
left join tas_bin_status tb
on tb.bin_code = cb.bin_code
where cb.mrta_select = 0 and cb.channel_code is not null and cb.channel_code <> ''
and [cb.map_code = ${mapCode}]
) as f
group by channel_code, status, map_code
) as f2
group by channel_code, map_code
) as f3 left join cms_elc_map ce on f3.map_code = ce.map_code

sources.content:
select f3.disabled_count + f3.is_empty + f3.is_full + f3.wait_out + f3.wait_in as all_count,
f3.*, ce.map_name
from (
select
channel_code, map_code,
max(case when status = 'disabled' then counts else 0 end) as disabled_count,   --已禁用
max(case when status = 'is_empty' then counts else 0 end) as is_empty,   --空仓
max(case when status = 'is_full' then counts else 0 end) as is_full,   -- 满仓
max(case when status = 'wait_out' then counts else 0 end) as wait_out, -- 待出库
max(case when status = 'wait_in' then counts else 0 end) as wait_in,    -- 待入库
max(case when status = 'task_out' then counts else 0 end) as task_out,    -- 出库在途
max(case when status = 'task_in' then counts else 0 end) as task_in    -- 入库在途
from (
select channel_code, status, count(1) as counts, map_code
from (
select cb.channel_code, cb.map_code, cb.bin_code, 
case when cb.enable_flag = 0 then 'disabled'
when sb.locked_out_capacity = 0 and sb.out_capacity = 0 then 'is_empty'
when sb.locked_out_capacity = 0 and sb.in_capacity = 0 then 'is_full'
when sb.locked_out_capacity > 0 and (tst.sub_task_gen_param::json -> 'interrupt')::text = '0' then 'wait_out'
when sb.locked_out_capacity > 0 and (tst.sub_task_gen_param::json -> 'interrupt')::text = '1' then 'wait_in' 
end as status
from cms_bin cb 
left join tas_bin_status sb on cb.bin_code = sb.bin_code
left join tas_slot_layer tsl on sb.bin_code = tsl.slot_code
left join tas_sub_task tst on tsl.sub_lock_source = tst.sub_task_code
where cb.mrta_select = 1
and cb.channel_code is not null and cb.channel_code <> ''
and [cb.map_code = ${mapCode}]
union all
select cb.channel_code, cb.map_code, cb.bin_code,
case when (ts.sub_task_gen_param::json -> 'interrupt')::text = '0' then 'task_out'
when (ts.sub_task_gen_param::json -> 'interrupt')::text = '1' then 'task_in' 
end as status
from tas_sub_task ts
left join cms_bin cb on ts.end_slot_code = cb.bin_code
where ts.end_slot_category = 'BIN' and ts.task_status not in ('5', '9', '10', '11')
and cb.mrta_select = 1 and cb.channel_code is not null and cb.channel_code <> ''
and [cb.map_code = ${mapCode}]
) as f
group by channel_code, status, map_code
) as f2
group by channel_code, map_code
) as f3 left join cms_elc_map ce on f3.map_code = ce.map_code

select source_code, main_type_code, minor_type_code, param1, param2,
alarm_x || ',' || alarm_y as coordinate,
to_char(begin_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as begin_time,

round(cast(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM end_date-begin_date)/60 as NUMERIC), 2) as times
from cms_alarm_log
where alarm_module = 1 and rss_id is not null
and end_date is not null
and [begin_date >= ${startTime}] and [begin_date <= ${endTime}]
and [rss_id in (${rssId})]
and [alarm_source in ${amrCode}]

from cms_elc_map cm, cms_area ca

and cm.map_code in (${mapCode})

from cms_area

where cm.map_code = ci.map_code

select map_code,count(1) as fault_times,current_timestamp-((date_trunc('day', CURRENT_DATE::TIMESTAMP))::TIMESTAMP) as online_time from
(
select map_code
from cms_amr_alarm_statistic
 where  map_code is not null and map_code!=''

and end_date < ((date_trunc('DAY', CURRENT_DATE::TIMESTAMP))::TIMESTAMP)
) t
group by map_code
) m where fault_times!=0
order by mtbf desc
 limit 5

select source_code, main_type_code, minor_type_code, param1, param2,
alarm_x || ',' || alarm_y as coordinate,
to_char(begin_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as begin_time, 
to_char(end_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as end_time, 
round(cast(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM end_date-begin_date)/60 as NUMERIC), 2) as times
from cms_alarm_log
where alarm_module = 1 and rss_id is not null
and end_date is not null
and [begin_date >= ${startTime}] and [begin_date <= ${endTime}]
and [rss_id = ${rssId}]
and [alarm_source in ${amrCode}]
order by begin_date asc

select rss_id, ca.map_code, cm.map_name, amr_code, 
to_char(begin_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as begin_time, 
to_char(end_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as end_time, 
round(cast(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM end_date-begin_date)/60 as NUMERIC), 2) as times
from cms_amr_alarm_statistic ca
left join cms_elc_map cm on cm.map_code = ca.map_code
where 1=1
and end_date is not null
and [begin_date >= ${startTime}] and [begin_date <= ${endTime}]
and case when ${rangeCode} <> '' and ${rangeCode} is not null then
		case when [${range1}::time <= ${range2}::time] then [begin_date::time >= ${range1}] and [begin_date::time <= ${range2}]
		else ([begin_date::time >= ${range1}] and begin_date::time <= '23:59:59') or (begin_date::time >= '00:00:00' and [begin_date::time <= ${range2}]) end
else 1=1 end
and [ca.map_code in (${mapCode})]
and [amr_code in (${amrCode})]

select count(1) as counts, 
round(cast(sum(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM end_date-begin_date))/60 as NUMERIC), 2) as times
from cms_amr_alarm_statistic 
where 1=1
and end_date is not null
and [begin_date >= ${startTime}] and [begin_date <= ${endTime}]
and case when ${rangeCode} <> '' and ${rangeCode} is not null then
		case when [${range1}::time <= ${range2}::time] then [begin_date::time >= ${range1}] and [begin_date::time <= ${range2}]
		else ([begin_date::time >= ${range1}] and begin_date::time <= '23:59:59') or (begin_date::time >= '00:00:00' and [begin_date::time <= ${range2}]) end 
else 1=1 end
and [map_code in (${mapCode})]
and [amr_code in (${amrCode})]

select map_code, s.time,fault_times from
(
	select map_code,d_time,count(1) as fault_times from
	(
	select elc_map_code as map_code,to_char(begin_date ,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24') as d_time
	from cms_alarm_log

select alarm_sub_type,count(*) from
(
	select alarm_module||'-'||main_type_code||'-'||minor_type_code as alarm_sub_type,source_code,end_date from cms_alarm_log
	where  elc_map_code is not null and elc_map_code<>'' and alarm_module=1
        and alarm_module||'-'||main_type_code||'-'||minor_type_code!='1-7-7'
	and end_date <date_trunc('day', CURRENT_DATE::TIMESTAMP) and (end_date >=(date_trunc('DAY', CURRENT_DATE::TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '7 day')::TIMESTAMP) 
) t group by alarm_sub_type
order by count desc
 limit 5
select map_code,map_name from cms_elc_map order by map_code

select coo_x as cooX, coo_y as cooY, 0 as counts, 'site' as type
from cms_site where [map_code=${mapcode}]
union all
select 
case when alarm_x=0 then 0 
	when alarm_x/250%2=0 then alarm_x/250/2*500
	when alarm_x/250%2=1 then (alarm_x/250/2+1)*500
	end as coox,
case when alarm_y=0 then 0 
	when alarm_y/250%2=0 then alarm_y/250/2*500
	when alarm_y/250%2=1 then (alarm_y/250/2+1)*500
	end as cooy,
count(1) as counts, 'alarm' as type
from cms_alarm_log where [elc_map_code=${mapcode}]
and [(${maintypeparam})] and [(${subtypeparam})]
and (CASE 
    WHEN ${timeCase} = '1' THEN (to_char(begin_date,'HH24:MI:SS')::time between ${startRange}::time and ${endRange}::time)
    WHEN ${timeCase} = '2' THEN (to_char(begin_date,'HH24:MI:SS')::time between ${startRange}::time and '24:00:00'::time or to_char(begin_date,'HH24:MI:SS')::time between '00:00:00'::time and ${endRange}::time)
    ELSE 1=1
END) = true
and (CASE 
    WHEN ${sqlCase} = '1' THEN (begin_date >= ${starttime} and begin_date <= ${endtime})
    ELSE 1=1
END) = true
and alarm_x <> 0 and alarm_y <> 0 and elc_map_code <> ''
group by coox, cooy

select source_code as amr_code,count(1) as fault_times from
(
select source_code
from cms_alarm_log
 where alarm_module=1 and elc_map_code is not null and elc_map_code<>''
and [alarm_classification in (${faultClasses})]
 and [elc_map_code in (${mapcodes})]  and  [source_code in (${robotcodes})]
and [alarm_module||'-'||main_type_code||'-'||minor_type_code in (${alarmTypes})]
and [alarm_module||'-'||main_type_code in (${mainAlarmTypes})]
and (CASE 
    WHEN ${paramCase} = '1' THEN (begin_date between timestamp${_startTime} and timestamp${_endTime})
    ELSE 1=1
END) = true 
and (CASE 
    WHEN ${ktCase} = '1' THEN (to_char(begin_date,'HH24:MI:SS')::time between time${range_start} and time${range_end})
    WHEN ${ktCase} = '2' THEN (to_char(begin_date,'HH24:MI:SS')::time between time${range_start} and time'24:00:00' or to_char(begin_date,'HH24:MI:SS')::time between time'00:00:00' and time${range_end})
    ELSE 1=1
END) = true 
and end_date is not null 
) t
group by source_code
order by fault_times desc

select source_code as amr_code,d_time,sum(fault_times) as fault_times from
(
	select source_code,d_time,count(1) as fault_times from
	(
	select source_code,
    (CASE 
        WHEN ${dTime1} = '1' THEN to_char(begin_date,'yyyy-mm')
        WHEN ${dTime1} = '2' THEN to_char(begin_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24')
        WHEN ${dTime1} = '3' THEN to_char(begin_date,'yyyy-mm-dd')
    END) AS d_time
	from cms_alarm_log  
	where alarm_module=1 and elc_map_code is not null and elc_map_code!=''
        and [alarm_classification in (${faultClasses})]
	and [elc_map_code in (${mapcodes})]  and end_date is not null
    and (CASE 
        WHEN ${paramCase} = '1' THEN (begin_date between timestamp${_startTime} and timestamp${_endTime})
        ELSE 1=1
    END) = true
    and (CASE 
        WHEN ${ltSql1Case} = '1' THEN (to_char(begin_date,'HH24:MI:SS')::time between time${range_start} and time'24:00:00')
        ELSE 1=1
    END) = true
    and (CASE 
        WHEN ${ytSql1Case} = '1' THEN (to_char(begin_date,'HH24:MI:SS')::time between time${range_start} and time${range_end})
        ELSE 1=1
    END) = true
and [alarm_module||'-'||main_type_code||'-'||minor_type_code in (${alarmTypes})]
and [alarm_module||'-'||main_type_code in (${mainAlarmTypes})]
	) m
	group by source_code,d_time
	union
	select source_code,d_time,count(1) as fault_times from
	(
	select source_code,
    (CASE 
        WHEN ${dTime2} = '1' THEN to_char(begin_date,'yyyy-mm')
        WHEN ${dTime2} = '2' THEN to_char(begin_date-interval'1day','yyyy-mm')
        WHEN ${dTime2} = '3' THEN to_char(begin_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24')
        WHEN ${dTime2} = '4' THEN to_char(begin_date,'yyyy-mm-dd')
        WHEN ${dTime2} = '5' THEN to_char(begin_date-interval'1day','yyyy-mm-dd')
    END) AS d_time
	from cms_alarm_log  
	where alarm_module=1 and elc_map_code is not null and elc_map_code!=''
        and [alarm_classification in (${alarmClasses})]
	and [elc_map_code in (${mapcodes})]  and end_date is not null
    and (CASE 
        WHEN ${paramCase} = '1' THEN (begin_date between timestamp${_startTime} and timestamp${_endTime})
        ELSE 1=1
    END) = true
    and (CASE 
        WHEN ${ltSql2Case} = '1' THEN (to_char(begin_date,'HH24:MI:SS')::time between time'00:00:00' and time${range_end})
        ELSE 1=1
    END) = true
    and (CASE 
        WHEN ${ytSql2Case} = '1' THEN (1=2)
        ELSE 1=1
    END) = true
and [alarm_module||'-'||main_type_code||'-'||minor_type_code in (${alarmTypes})]
and [alarm_module||'-'||main_type_code in (${mainAlarmTypes})]
	) m
	group by source_code,d_time
) s group by source_code,d_time
order by d_time asc,source_code

select
	code as type_code,
	type_name,
	1 as biz
from
	cms_biz_group_type
union
select
	key_ as type_code,
	case
		when s.field_value is null then t.def_name
		else s.field_value
	end as type_name,
	0 as biz
from
	act_re_procdef
left join tas_procdef as t on
	act_re_procdef.id_ = t.id
left join glory_sys_lang s on
	s.field_code = t.def_name,
	(
	select
		key_ as bkey,
		max(version_) as bversion
	from
		act_re_procdef
	group by
		key_) as b
where
	act_re_procdef.key_ = b.bkey
	and act_re_procdef.version_ = b.bversion
	and (s.field_type = 'processDefinition'
	or s.field_type is null)
	and (s.lang_type = 'zh-CN'
	or s.lang_type is null)
order by
	biz desc,
	type_code asc

select coo_x, coo_y, site_code from cms_site
where [map_code = ${mapcode}]

select type_code||'-'||parent_code||'-'||alarm_type_code as key, name
from (
select distinct type_code,parent_code,alarm_type_code,glory_sys_lang.field_value as name  from cms_alarm_type join glory_sys_lang 
on (cms_alarm_type.alarm_type_name=glory_sys_lang.field_code or cms_alarm_type.alarm_type_name=glory_sys_lang.field_value)
where parent_code is not null
and glory_sys_lang.field_type='alarmTypeName' and glory_sys_lang.lang_type='zh-CN' 
) t where type_code||'-'||parent_code||'-'||alarm_type_code is not null 
order by type_code,parent_code,alarm_type_code

select source_code as robot_code,elc_map_code as map_code,count(*) from
(
	select alarm_module||'-'||main_type_code||'-'||minor_type_code as alarm_sub_type,source_code,elc_map_code from cms_alarm_log
	where  elc_map_code is not null and elc_map_code<>'' and alarm_module=1 and alarm_classification  in (0,2)  
        and alarm_module||'-'||main_type_code||'-'||minor_type_code!='1-7-7' and [elc_map_code in (${mapcodes})] and [source_code in (${robotcodes})]
	and (CASE
    WHEN ${rangeCase} = '1' THEN (to_char(begin_date,'HH24:MI:SS')::time between time${range_start} and time'23:59:59' and to_char(begin_date,'HH24:MI:SS')::time >= time'00:00:00' and to_char(begin_date,'HH24:MI:SS')::time < time${range_end})
    ELSE (to_char(begin_date,'HH24:MI:SS')::time >= time${range_start} and to_char(begin_date,'HH24:MI:SS')::time < time${range_end})
    END) = true
    and (CASE
    WHEN ${dateCase} = '1' THEN (begin_date >= date_trunc('week',now()) and begin_date< current_date+1)
    WHEN ${dateCase} = '2' THEN (begin_date >= date_trunc('month',now()) and begin_date < current_date+1)
    ELSE (begin_date >= timestamp${_startTime} and begin_date <timestamp${_endTime})
    END) = true
) t group by source_code,elc_map_code 
order by count desc

select concat(coo_x, '-', coo_y, '-',map_code) as code from cms_site
where site_type in ('11', '35')
and [map_code in (${mapcodes})]
order by map_code, coo_x, coo_y

select amr_code,round(cast(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM end_date-begin_date)/3600 as NUMERIC),2) as ft_time
from cms_amr_alarm_statistic
 where map_code is not null and map_code<>''
 and [map_code in (${mapcodes})] and [begin_date >=${startTime}] and [end_date < ${endTime}] and map_code is not null and map_code!=''
) t
group by amr_code
order by fault_times asc
 limit 10

select alarm_module,main_type_code,count(*) from cms_alarm_log
 where [elc_map_code in (${mapcodes})] and [begin_date >=${startTime}] and [end_date < ${endTime}] and [(${param})]
group by alarm_module,main_type_code
select distinct map_code as mapcode from cms_amr_alarm_statistic  where map_code is not null and map_code!='' and [end_date >=${startTime}] and [end_date < ${endTime}] order by map_code

select amr_code,map_code,count(1) as fault_times,sum(ft_time) as fault_time from
(
select amr_code,map_code,round(cast(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM end_date-begin_date)/3600 as NUMERIC),2) as ft_time
from cms_amr_alarm_statistic
  where [map_code in (${mapcodes})] and [end_date >=${startTime}] and [end_date < ${endTime}] and map_code is not null and map_code!=''
) t
group by amr_code,map_code
order by fault_times desc

select map_code,count(1) as fault_times,sum(ft_time) as fault_time,count(1) as fault_times from
(
select amr_code,map_code,round(cast(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM end_date-begin_date)/3600 as NUMERIC),2) as ft_time
from cms_amr_alarm_statistic
 where  [map_code in (${mapcodes})] and [end_date >=${startTime}] and [end_date < ${endTime}] and map_code is not null and map_code!=''
) t
group by map_code
order by  fault_times desc

select alarm_module,main_type_code,minor_type_code,count(*) from cms_alarm_log 
where  [elc_map_code in (${mapcodes})] and [begin_date >=${startTime}] and [begin_date < ${endTime}] and [(${param})] and end_date is not null
group by alarm_module,main_type_code,minor_type_code
order by count desc
 limit 10

select task_chain_type
,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM  sum(task_start_time-send_task_time))/3600  as reply_time
,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM  sum(end_time-create_time))/3600  as exec_time
,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM  sum(load_item_time-create_time))/3600  as carrier_lift_time
,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM  sum(load_item_time-task_start_time))/3600  as empty_run_time
from tbl_sub_task
where [map_code in (${mapcodes})] and [create_time >=${startTime}] and [create_time < ${endTime}]
group by task_chain_type

sources.sourceName: 故障次数等相关统计总
sources.content:
select sum(ft_time) as fault_time,count(1) as fault_times
,[EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (to_timestamp(${endTime},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:MI:SS')-to_timestamp(${startTime},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:MI:SS')))/3600 as pl_time]
from
(
select amr_code,map_code,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM end_date-begin_date)/3600 as ft_time
from cms_amr_alarm_statistic
where [map_code in (${mapcodes})] and [begin_date >=${startTime}] and [end_date < ${endTime}]
) t

select type_code||'-'||alarm_type_code as key,glory_sys_lang.field_value as name from cms_alarm_type join glory_sys_lang on cms_alarm_type.alarm_type_name=glory_sys_lang.field_code 
where  cms_alarm_type.parent_code is null 
and glory_sys_lang.field_type='alarmTypeName' and glory_sys_lang.lang_type='zh-CN'  
and (parent_code IS NULL OR parent_code = 0)
and [type_code=${module}] -- and alarm_classification in (${class})
order by type_code,alarm_type_code

select type_code||'-'||parent_code||'-'||alarm_type_code as key,name from 
(
select distinct type_code,parent_code,alarm_type_code,glory_sys_lang.field_value as name 
from cms_alarm_type join glory_sys_lang on (cms_alarm_type.alarm_type_name=glory_sys_lang.field_code or cms_alarm_type.alarm_type_name=glory_sys_lang.field_value )
where  cms_alarm_type.parent_code is not null and 
glory_sys_lang.field_type='alarmTypeName' and glory_sys_lang.lang_type='zh-CN'
) t where type_code||'-'||parent_code||'-'||alarm_type_code is not null 
order by type_code,parent_code,alarm_type_code

select amr_code,map_code,sum(ft_time) as fault_time,count(1) as fault_times from
(
select amr_code,map_code,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM end_date-begin_date)/3600 as ft_time
from cms_amr_alarm_statistic
where [map_code in (${mapcodes})] and [begin_date >=${startTime}] and [end_date < ${endTime}]
) t
group by amr_code,map_code

select type_code||'-'||alarm_type_code as key,name from  (
select distinct type_code,parent_code,alarm_type_code,glory_sys_lang.field_value as name  from cms_alarm_type join glory_sys_lang on cms_alarm_type.alarm_type_name=glory_sys_lang.field_code 
where  [type_code=${module}] and 
cms_alarm_type.parent_code is null   and glory_sys_lang.field_type='alarmTypeName' and glory_sys_lang.lang_type='zh-CN'  
) t where type_code||'-'||alarm_type_code is not null 
order by type_code,alarm_type_code

select * from cms_alarm_log
where  [elc_map_code in (${mapcodes})] 
and [source_code in (${sourceCodes})]
and [alarm_module=${module}] and [alarm_classification in (${class})]
and  [begin_date >=${startTime}] and [begin_date < ${endTime}] 
and ( ${alarmStatus} in('','1,2','2,1') or ${alarmStatus}='1' and end_date is null or ${alarmStatus}='2' and  end_date is not null)
and [(${param})] order by ${sort}

select type_code||'-'||alarm_type_code as key,field_value as name from
(
select distinct type_code,alarm_type_code,glory_sys_lang.field_value  from cms_alarm_type join glory_sys_lang on cms_alarm_type.alarm_type_name=glory_sys_lang.field_code 
where   cms_alarm_type.parent_code is null  
and glory_sys_lang.field_type='alarmTypeName' and glory_sys_lang.lang_type='zh-CN'  
) t order by type_code,alarm_type_code

select type_code||'-'||parent_code||'-'||alarm_type_code as key, name
from (
select distinct type_code,parent_code,alarm_type_code,glory_sys_lang.field_value as name  from cms_alarm_type join glory_sys_lang 
on (cms_alarm_type.alarm_type_name=glory_sys_lang.field_code or cms_alarm_type.alarm_type_name=glory_sys_lang.field_value)
where  [cms_alarm_type.alarm_classification in (${classes})] and parent_code is not null
and glory_sys_lang.field_type='alarmTypeName' and glory_sys_lang.lang_type='zh-CN'  and [${param}] 
) t where type_code||'-'||parent_code||'-'||alarm_type_code is not null 
order by type_code,parent_code,alarm_type_code
